business_problem: Riversoft needed a better way to support semantic travel search and automated travel product matching because its first-generation travel AI delivered slow inference, weak relevance, and too much manual effort when matching traveler requests to packages.
solution_summary: Riversoft uses Serverless compute and Amazon Bedrock to support semantic travel search and automated travel product matching. The implementation replaced a legacy state where its first-generation travel AI delivered slow inference, weak relevance, and too much manual effort when matching traveler requests to packages. Travel catalog content and customer travel queries move through AWS Lambda and land in shared lakehouse datasets, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Central governance keeps access, lineage, and compliance consistent across downstream teams. Serverless compute, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon SageMaker operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver semantic travel matches and itinerary and package recommendations.
business_outcome: Riversoft improved semantic travel search and automated travel product matching with measurable results including Riversoft Reduces Inferencing Time for Smart Travel System by 75% with Generative AI on AWS, reduction in inferencing time, from 20 to 5 seconds, and 75% lower costs for hosting llms, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
